channel.title: PRESS RELEASES FROM RBI
channel.description: This is Feed from RBI for Press Releases.

item.title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Fixture Co-operative Bank Ltd
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has imposed a monetary penalty of 2.5 lakh on Fixture Co-operative Bank Ltd for non-compliance with directions.

item.title: Monetary Policy Statement - Fixture Resolution of the MPC
item.description: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged.
